summary: Procure HIPAA-enabled transcription seats for clinical pilot; SCIM/Okta + invoice routing
description:
Issue summary:
We need to procure temporary HIPAA-enabled transcription seats for a 6-week clinical pilot with a partner. The pilot will run in us-east and requires a signed BAA, SCIM provisioning via Okta, regional data residency (US), and invoice routing to specific cost centers.

Impact:
- Pilot kickoff scheduled for 2026-04-06; lack of seats + compliance paperwork blocks partner engagement and data ingestion testing.
- Small cross-functional team (~12 users) needs access immediately for evaluation; inability to provide HIPAA controls risks losing the pilot.

Request details / ask:
- Vendor: TranscribeNow (enterprise plan with HIPAA add-on) — initial quote requested via vendor sales.
- Quantity: 12 seats active, plus 3 overflow seats for contractors (total 15).
- Duration: 6 weeks (trial/PO with option to convert to annual contract).
- Billing: One-time trial invoice charged to cost center 4302-CLIN-PILOT and tagged to project tag CLIN-PILOT-0426.
- Procurement path: Purchase order preferred; if vendor requires CC, use delegated procurement card with subsequent invoicing and PO reconciliation.

Security / compliance requirements:
- Signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA) required before any PHI is uploaded.
- Vendor must confirm US-only data residency and no cross-border backups.
- Access control: SCIM provisioning required; Okta app + group mapping (groups: clinical-pilot-admins, clinical-pilot-users).
- SSO: SAML + SCIM provisioning; deprovisioning SLA <= 24 hours.
- Audit logs: 90 days retention minimum; export location for logs requested.

Technical integration notes:
- Admins will need role-scoped API keys for automated ingestion tests. Request vendor to provision dev sandbox with same compliance posture.
- VPN/IP allowlist optional but desired for earliest stage (vendor to accept IP ranges from us-east office egress).

Invoice and accounting:
- Invoice routing: Accounts Payable contact: Jordan Patel; code with GL account 4302 and tag CLIN-PILOT-0426.
- Approval flow: Budget owner Bethany Rivera (Research Ops), Finance approver: Jordan Patel.

Steps to reproduce / next actions:
1) Procurement to request final enterprise quote including HIPAA add-on and short-term PO pricing from TranscribeNow sales (assigned: Oliver).
2) Security to validate vendor SOC2/ISO reports and confirm BAA template (assigned: Priya Malhotra).
3) Okta/SRE to pre-create groups and map SCIM attributes for fast provisioning (assigned: Diego Ramos).
4) Finance to prepare PO template and confirm cost-center GL mapping and payment method (assigned: Jordan Patel).
5) Legal to review and sign BAA; aim for e-sign by 2026-03-25.

Acceptance criteria:
- Signed BAA in place and stored in vendor contract repository.
- 15 seats provisioned via SCIM/Okta and verified with at least 3 pilot users able to upload test files without PHI leakage.
- Invoice or PO issued and assigned to cost center in accounting system.

Linked artifacts:
- related_confluence_pages: ["confluence.cloud.redwood/CLIN-PILOT-TranscribeNow-onboarding", "confluence.cloud.redwood/BAA-templates"]
- related_github_prs: ["N/A"]
- linked_issues: ["INT-67210", "INT-31204"]

Notes / investigation so far:
- Sales rep (contact: amy.hughes@transcribenow.com) provided a draft quote and BAA template on 2026-03-09.
- Vendor confirmed SCIM + SAML support and US data residency but requested legal review for BAA language around subcontractors.
- Preliminary cost estimate: $1,350 for 6-week trial (12 seats) or $12,000/yr for 15 seats enterprise plan; final pricing pending negotiation.

Risks / blockers:
- BAA negotiation could add 5–10 business days.
- Vendor requests CC for trial which may require procurement-card workflow and manual reconciliation.

Current status and immediate next steps (as of 2026-03-12):
- Procurement reached out to vendor for a formal PO-friendly quote and trial pricing (Oliver assigned).
- Security requested vendor evidence packet (SOC2/iso) and BAA redline; legal loop-in scheduled for 2026-03-13.
- Okta team will create SCIM group skeleton once vendor confirms attribute schema.

Please update this ticket with: quote PDF, signed BAA, final PO number, and SCIM attribute mapping when available.
